# SIT 3D Digital Twin — Siliguri Institute of Technology

> Interactive 3D campus exploration, building directory, walking navigation, and virtual fresher tour for Siliguri Institute of Technology (SIT), Salbari, West Bengal, India.

## Overview
- **Institution:** Siliguri Institute of Technology (SIT)
- **Official Institution Website:** https://www.sittechno.org
- **Platform:** SIT 3D Digital Twin (WebGL / Three.js interactive campus map)
- **Primary Capabilities:**
  - Interactive 3D campus map with Day Mode and Night Mode lighting
  - Building directory with floor-by-floor room, lab, and department listings
  - Real-time search across academic blocks, laboratories, hostels, canteen, and sports facilities
  - A* graph-based campus walking directions between any two campus locations
  - Guided 9-stop Fresher Orientation Virtual Tour

## Public Pages
- `/` — Interactive 3D Campus Digital Twin (WebGL map, search, building explorer, directions, and virtual tour)
- `/campus-guide` — Crawlable guide, building directory overview, and frequently asked questions about the SIT 3D Digital Twin
- `/sitemap.xml` — XML sitemap of public pages
- `/robots.txt` — Search engine crawler directives
